## otp-vault 0.2.1: updated libraries

otp-vault works exactly as in 0.2.0.

- **Security:** updated `golang.org/x/crypto` to 0.59.0, which fixes GO-2026-5932. otp-vault does not use the affected code, the update keeps it out of the program anyway. `golang.org/x/net`, `x/sys` and `x/text` are updated along with it.
- **README:** new screenshots and a clear disclaimer: otp-vault is free hobby software without any warranty. Keep an independent backup of your two-factor secrets.

The files are not digitally signed yet; Windows SmartScreen may warn. Every file is built by GitHub Actions from this repository, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists their checksums.
